tours.name: Onboard a New Hire
tours.description: Learn how to prepare a new hire's onboarding: set their manager and user account, launch the onboarding plan that creates their to-do list, and find their documents and equipment.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to prepare a new hire's onboarding: set their manager and user account, launch the onboarding plan that creates their to-do list, and find their documents and equipment.

steps.title: Open Employees
steps.description: Onboarding starts from the new hire's employee record, so go to the Employees app first. Create the record beforehand if the person does not exist yet.

description_i18n.en_US: Onboarding starts from the new hire's employee record, so go to the Employees app first. Create the record beforehand if the person does not exist yet.

steps.title: Open the new hire
steps.content: Click the new hire's card to open the record.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the new hire's card to open the record.

steps.description: Each card is one employee. Click the card of the person you are onboarding to open their form.

description_i18n.en_US: Each card is one employee. Click the card of the person you are onboarding to open their form.

steps.title: Open Manager
steps.content: Click here to choose the manager.

content_i18n.en_US: Click here to choose the manager.

steps.description: The onboarding plan assigns some tasks to the new hire's manager, so a manager must be set before the plan can be launched.

description_i18n.en_US: The onboarding plan assigns some tasks to the new hire's manager, so a manager must be set before the plan can be launched.

steps.title: Choose the manager
steps.content: Click the new hire's manager. If you do not see it in the short list, click Search More... and pick it in the window that opens.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the new hire's manager. If you do not see it in the short list, click Search More... and pick it in the window that opens.

steps.description: Pick the person the new hire reports to. Start typing a name to narrow the list.

description_i18n.en_US: Pick the person the new hire reports to. Start typing a name to narrow the list.

steps.title: HR Settings tab
steps.description: The related user account is set in this tab. The onboarding plan needs it, because tasks are assigned to the employee's user.

description_i18n.en_US: The related user account is set in this tab. The onboarding plan needs it, because tasks are assigned to the employee's user.

steps.title: Open Related User
steps.content: Click here to choose the user account.

content_i18n.en_US: Click here to choose the user account.

steps.description: The related user is the login the new hire will use. Linking it lets Odoo assign tasks to them and show them their own records.

description_i18n.en_US: The related user is the login the new hire will use. Linking it lets Odoo assign tasks to them and show them their own records.

steps.title: Choose the user
steps.content: Click the new hire's user account. If you do not see it in the short list, click Search More... and pick it in the window that opens.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the new hire's user account. If you do not see it in the short list, click Search More... and pick it in the window that opens.

steps.description: Select the user that belongs to this employee. If there is no user yet, create one first from the Settings app.

description_i18n.en_US: Select the user that belongs to this employee. If there is no user yet, create one first from the Settings app.

steps.title: Save
steps.content: Click the save icon to keep the changes.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the save icon to keep the changes.

steps.description: Save the manager and user before you launch the plan, so the plan can read them.

description_i18n.en_US: Save the manager and user before you launch the plan, so the plan can read them.

steps.title: Launch Plan
steps.content: Click Launch Plan to start the onboarding.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Launch Plan to start the onboarding.

steps.description: A plan is a ready-made checklist. Launching it creates the to-do tasks for the right people, so nothing is forgotten.

description_i18n.en_US: A plan is a ready-made checklist. Launching it creates the to-do tasks for the right people, so nothing is forgotten.

steps.title: Plan summary
steps.content: Review the tasks the plan will create. Click the list to continue.

content_i18n.en_US: Review the tasks the plan will create. Click the list to continue.

steps.description: The summary shows each to-do and who it will be assigned to. Check it before you launch, because every person listed will receive a task.

description_i18n.en_US: The summary shows each to-do and who it will be assigned to. Check it before you launch, because every person listed will receive a task.

steps.title: Schedule the plan
steps.content: Click Schedule to create the tasks.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Schedule to create the tasks.

steps.description: Schedule creates the tasks and assigns them to the people listed. Each person then finds their task in their activity list.

description_i18n.en_US: Schedule creates the tasks and assigns them to the people listed. Each person then finds their task in their activity list.

steps.title: Documents
steps.content: Click Documents to see the employee's files.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Documents to see the employee's files.

steps.description: The Documents button opens the employee's folder, where contracts, identity papers and other files are kept.

description_i18n.en_US: The Documents button opens the employee's folder, where contracts, identity papers and other files are kept.

steps.title: Back to the employee
steps.content: Click the employee's name to go back.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the employee's name to go back.

steps.description: The path at the top shows where you are. Click the employee's name to return to their record.

description_i18n.en_US: The path at the top shows where you are. Click the employee's name to return to their record.

steps.title: Equipment
steps.content: Click Equipment to see what is assigned.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Equipment to see what is assigned.

steps.description: The Equipment button opens the company equipment assigned to this employee, such as a laptop or phone.

description_i18n.en_US: The Equipment button opens the company equipment assigned to this employee, such as a laptop or phone.

steps.title: Equipment list
steps.content: This list shows the equipment assigned to the employee. Click the search bar to finish.

content_i18n.en_US: This list shows the equipment assigned to the employee. Click the search bar to finish.

steps.description: Onboarding is prepared: the manager and user are set, the plan has created the tasks, and the documents and equipment are one click away. Use this list to assign a laptop, phone or other equipment to the new hire.

description_i18n.en_US: Onboarding is prepared: the manager and user are set, the plan has created the tasks, and the documents and equipment are one click away. Use this list to assign a laptop, phone or other equipment to the new hire.
